name: Continuum Calendar
tagline: Your week, your devices, your rules — without a subscription.
pitch: Continuum is a free and open-source calendar for people who want Google when it’s useful, local privacy when it’s not, and the same agenda on phone and desktop without paying a Pro tax.
features: Rolling week from today with explicit Open empty days
Google Calendar sync with peer settings and local-event overlays
Desktop MIT app plus Android GPL-3 Fossify Calendar fork
Cyan + purple infinity brand mark — owned Continuum identity
quick_start: Clone the repo and open it in Cursor.
install: Desktop and Android releases on GitHub Releases. Local: Node 20+ for Tauri; JDK 17+ for Android/KMP.
usage: Use `/bootstrap` / `/build` / `/verify` per `docs/help/BATCH_COMMANDS.md`. Regen brand icons: `python3 scripts/generate-infinity-mark.py`.
